summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection against current selected read-set bytes and yield validator-owned successor context; knowledgeSelectionHash excludes source bytes; knowledgeContextHash binds selection,current source hashes,snapshot,Locator,decisions,predecessor; authority-envelope hash binds ADRs,rules,policies,contracts,registries,allowed successor kinds; stale freshness/query-quality may allow degraded execution for unrelated targets when selection,authority,required modules,current read-set verify; publication failure never advances current/LKG and preserves valid LKG for degraded consumption; selection/authority/contract/command-test/policy/protected-path/source-integrity/Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid-evolution permits same-selection validator successor only for non-Knowledge self-change, never publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release requires current published Knowledge,publication-quality checks,applicable semantic-review evidence; consumers may choose stricter profile without changing shared LKG/publication ownership; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop execution interpretation; publication query gate and LKG integrity remain strict.
